import { Controller, Inject, Injectable, Module, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ClientProxy, ClientsModule, Transport } from '@nestjs/microservices';
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';

@Injectable()
export class ReportDispatchService {
  constructor(@Inject('REPORT_QUEUE') private readonly client: ClientProxy) {}

  enqueue(payload: unknown) {
    return firstValueFrom(this.client.send('report.generate', payload));
  }
}

@Controller('reports')
export class ReportController {
  constructor(private readonly reports: ReportDispatchService) {}

  @Post()
  create() {
    return this.reports.enqueue({ requested: true });
  }
}

@Module({
  imports: [
    ClientsModule.register([
      {
        name: 'REPORT_QUEUE',
        transport: Transport.RMQ,
        options: { queue: 'reports_queue' },
      },
    ]),
  ],
  controllers: [ReportController],
  providers: [ReportDispatchService],
})
export class ReportApiModule {}
